subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: The system shall record no free-text content — no prompt body, command string, tool output body, or source text — in any record.
rationale: keeps the record set free of secret-bearing text and of prompt-logging obligations *(#D-9)*
fit_criterion: schema inspection finds no content-bearing field; a record produced from a transcript containing a known secret string does not contain that string
